readmeExcerpt: This example demonstrates how to implement event-based CDC in Spring Boot  using [Spring JMS](https://spring.io/guides/gs/messaging-jms) and [Oracle AI Database Transactional Event Queues](https://docs.oracle.com/en/database/oracle/oracle-database/26/adque/aq-introduction.html). In the example app, a service inserts database records, and a Spring JMS consumer reacts to each insert event.
